name: mr-tapioca
description: Mr. Tapioca — boba focus app. Web app + Capacitor iOS shell (with a native Screen Time blocker).

scripts.ios:sync: node tools/check-capacitor-versions.mjs && node tools/patch-capacitor-tar.mjs && npm run copyweb && node_modules/.bin/cap sync ios && node tools/register-ios-plugins.mjs
scripts.ios:release-setup: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run ios:sync && node tools/set-ios-version.mjs 1.1.1 9
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && node_modules/.bin/cap open ios
